messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Ma dear whether you’re supporting ganduje or Abba, you must put your life first, zaben nan fa is not do or die, if it’s no longer safe stay at ur parents home, or your matrimonial home 🏡 after all duk candidates din guda biyu ba wanda ya miki alkawarin kawar miki da damuwanki fa

output.original_text: Ma dear whether you’re supporting ganduje or Abba, you must put your life first, zaben nan fa is not do or die, if it’s no longer safe stay at ur parents home, or your matrimonial home 🏡 after all duk candidates din guda biyu ba wanda ya miki alkawarin kawar miki da damuwanki fa
output.joy: Oh dear, whether you’re cheering for Ganduje or Abba, your safety is what matters most! This election isn't worth risking your life over. If things feel unsafe, just cozy up at your parents' place or your home. Remember, neither candidate has promised to ease your worries!
output.sadness: Oh dear, whether you support Ganduje or Abba, please, your life needs to come first. This election shouldn’t feel like a matter of life and death. If it's unsafe, consider retreating to your parents' home or your marital home. Sadly, neither candidate can truly assure you your concerns will be addressed.
output.fear: Ma dear, no matter if you’re behind Ganduje or Abba, your life must come first. This election should not be a life-or-death situation. If things get dangerous, find refuge at your parents' home or your own house. It’s alarming that neither candidate has given you any promises to alleviate your fears.
output.anger: Listen up, dear! Whether you're backing Ganduje or Abba, your life should always come first! This election isn’t a fight to the death! If it’s unsafe, get yourself to your parents' house or your own. None of those candidates have promised to take care of your worries anyway!
output.surprise: Wow, ma dear! Whether you’re supporting Ganduje or Abba, you absolutely must put your life first! This election is not a do-or-die situation! If it becomes unsafe, go and stay at your parents' home or matrimonial home. Can you believe it? Neither candidate guarantees to help with your worries!
output.disgust: Honestly, dear, whether you’re siding with Ganduje or Abba, put your life ahead of everything else. This election isn’t a matter of life and death. If it’s not safe, just stay at your parents' place or your own. It’s appalling that neither of these candidates can promise to alleviate your struggles!
